kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller
Hardcoded database credentials (postgres:postgres) and port (54422) in qa:seed:verify script should use environment variables instead.
migrate.stdout could be null (spawnSync defaults stdio[1] to 'inherit'), but is accessed without a null check
status.stdout could be null (spawnSync defaults stdio[1] to 'inherit'), but is accessed without a null check
Accessing argv[ttlArgIdx + 1] without bounds check; if --ttl is the final argument, this passes undefined to parseTtl unexpectedly
products.find() result is used with non-null assertion (!) without runtime check; will crash at runtime if find() returns undefined due to data inconsistency.
Missing validation for '--only' argument; if specified without a value, args[onlyIndex + 1] returns undefined and the flag is silently ignored, seeding all domains instead of erroring.
Destructured [row] from query result without checking if rows exist; accessing row.live will crash if query returns zero rows.

Destructured [membership] from query result without checking if rows exist; accessing membership.n will crash if query returns zero rows.
Destructured [roles] from query result without checking if rows exist; accessing roles.n will crash if query returns zero rows.
Non-null assertion on registered.get('att.file.near-quota') without prior existence check; fails silently if matrix id was not registered by seed.
Destructured [row] from query result without checking if rows exist; accessing row.size_bytes will crash if query returns zero rows.
